The structure of Pr2Mg10Sn2 (PrMg5Sn) crystallizes in the tetragonal space group I-4m2 (No. 119), with 14 atoms per unit cell across 4 independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis shows Mg and Sn centers each with 12 geometric neighbors in close-packed-like local arrangements, while Pr centers have 16 neighbors. Mg–Mg polyhedra share corners, edges, and faces, and Mg–Sn polyhedra share edges; the periodic neighbor graph forms a single 3D component containing all 14 sites.
